name: tododesk-monorepo
description: Dayfolio —— Mac 桌面待办事项 + 学习计划 + 打卡应用，含 MCP 接口

scripts.build:mcp: npm run ontology:sync && node apps/mcp/scripts/build.mjs && npm run agent:catalog
scripts.test:mcp: npm run build:mcp && vitest run apps/mcp/test
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core --noEmit && tsc -p apps/desktop --noEmit && tsc -p apps/mcp --noEmit
scripts.build:desktop: node node_modules/electron/install.js && npm run agent:build && npm run ontology:sync && npm run rebuild:native && npm run build:web && node apps/desktop/scripts/build.mjs
scripts.build:web: npm run help:sync && npm run agent:catalog && cd apps/desktop && npx vite build
scripts.plugin:verify: npm run agent:verify && node packages/agent-kit/scripts/legacy.mjs --verify && node apps/plugin/scripts/verify-sports-skill.mjs
